data.title: RYBREVANT FASPRO™ (amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj) plus LAZCLUZE® (lazertinib) with prophylactic strategies shows low rates of treatment-related events at WCLC 2026
data.description: New data from Johnson & Johnson revealed minimal rates of rash, blood clots, and administration-related reactions with subcutaneous treatment and prophylaxis. Less than 1% of patients stopped treatment due to treatment-related issues within one year. These latest findings contribute to the ongoing MARIPOSA survival study.

data.title: Mitsubishi Electric Invests in OptQC Startup Developing Optical Quantum Computer Hardware
data.description: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation, based in Tokyo and listed as 6503, revealed its investment in OptQC Corp., a Japanese startup specializing in optical quantum computer hardware. This marks the sixteenth investment by the ME Innovation Fund. The shift of quantum computing from theoretical to practical applications has led to increased industrial advancements and a growing need for high-capacity hardware. Industries are now seeking technology that can support the demands of these evolving applications.
